summary: Integrated 18.1 contract and source expose exact PreparedSourceApproval tuple and mandatory current-authority verifier. IPreparedSourceReadContext has only ListAsync, ReadTextRangeAsync and SearchTextAsync plus lifetime/disposal; PreparedSourceContextIssuer receives application-held PhysicalRootPath, opens root privately and returns a context. No public physical-root lease exists. Story 18.2 accepted plan adds a separate trusted tool-purpose lease without modifying these 18.1 contracts.
